protocol.selection: maximum validation Wilson lower bound; >=30 calls across all 3 validation seasons; <=20% coverage
protocol.probabilityMeaning: cover conditional on a non-push outcome; pickem games abstained
protocol.calibration: Platt on earlier OOS forecasts only, minimum 400 prior decisions; nonpositive slope => neutral
protocol.strongEvidence: Wilson lower95 >55% and Bonferroni-adjusted one-sided binomial p<.05; independence caveat applies

warnings: 2023–2025 were previously viewed: retrospective test, not pristine holdout.
Bonferroni corrects search count but binomial/Wilson assume independent, stationary trials; games/seasons are correlated.
Selected candidate is not a trusted 55% policy unless strong prior evidence exists; otherwise production-style policy abstains.
No observed outcome can establish the true probability of one unique matchup.
